M3.02 independent RE-REVIEW at 16f77784ea706ee6c0db5f53a9d7eda976277b5b (vs reviewed 8becf752) — verdict APPROVE-WITH-FIXES (source-level; nothing compiled or run).
Blobs: PatternArtifact.scala 08e9cd61, PatternArtifactSuite.scala 9ae8bb26, AlderPatternArtifact.scala bfd5ea88, AlderPatternArtifactSuite.scala 7f905321. Fresh-context reviewer; new finding A re-verified by me at :78-97.

PRIOR MAJORS
1 intercept/centering: RESOLVED. ExplicitIntercept(values: AxisValues[?], targetCenteringReceipt) :26; separate neural/target receipts :25; forwardMean adds intercept :160-165; axis + non-blank receipts checked :181-183. Hand check: A=(1,2)^T, C=3, y=4 -> (12,24) + (7,-5) = (19,19) = suite :71-72.
2 rank tolerance: RESOLVED (see A). Max-abs scaling + Cholesky pivotTolerance = rel * max Gram diag, rel in (0,1), recorded in VerifiedByGaleGramCholesky :37/:127; Gram conditioning limitation documented :74-77. Near-singular fixture: pivot ~5e-15 vs tol ~2e-12 -> refused with margin; [s s; s 2s] admitted at s=1e+-150; [1 2;2 4] pivot exactly 0 -> refused.
3 callable forwardMean: RESOLVED by reasoning, NOT compiled. Param now AxisValues[?] :111; suite :55-56 calls artifact.factors.forwardMean and artifact.forwardMean. Construction at :165 relies on wildcard capture — confirm with the JVM+JS gate.
4 negative tests: MOSTLY RESOLVED. Variant-specific, single-cause. Gaps: DeclaredSolverDiagnostic refusal test removed (coverage regression); AlderPatternArtifactSuite still isLeft-only. (r<=0 and artifact-level K-1 are unreachable — see nit D.)

PRIOR MINORS: 5,6,8,9,12 documented caveats; 10 fixed (reports K-1, branch unreachable); 7 weakly documented (say explicitly no loadings/Psi stored); 11 UNRESOLVED and undocumented (TrainingScopeMismatch still conflates wrong expected receipt vs wrong binding digest, Alder :27).

NEW
A (minor, should fix) rank admission depends on the unfixed component scale (:78-97): one global max-abs scalar, not per column. Under CoordinateGauge.UnfixedBasis, (A D, C D^-1) is equivalent to (A, C), yet orthogonal A with column norms 1 and 1e-7 gives pivot 1e-14 <= 1e-12 -> refused, while the gauge-equivalent rescale is admitted. Fix: Jacobi-scale the Gram (G_ij / sqrt(G_ii G_jj)), refuse zero columns, compare pivot to rel.
B (minor) target mean not stored: ExplicitIntercept keeps only a target-centering receipt string; forwardMean on uncentered continuous y silently shifts. Store the target mean on the target axis or document that callers must centre y (:157).
C (minor) centered() uses absolute 1e-10 (:100-101): tiny-scale non-centered contrasts pass, large-magnitude rounding may be refused. Make relative to column abs-sum.
D (nit) :171-179 artifact-level K-1 branch unreachable (components <= min(p,q), q <= K-1 enforced by geometry); remove or mark defensive.
E (nit) continuous AxisMismatch reports literal "foreign axis" (:71) instead of the key.
F (nit) Alder suite should match TrainingScopeMismatch variant (ideally after splitting per 11).

Portability: shared code uses Gale DMat, companion given Backend, math only.
Before landing: A, B (store or document), 11 (split or document), restore the DeclaredSolverDiagnostic refusal test; then JVM+JS gates to settle 3.
